verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs say agents on any MCP client can run trends, funnels, retention and SQL queries through a free hosted MCP server, including HogQL via Claude and an execute-sql tool. There is also an authenticated /query API endpoint for HogQL and a CLI `api` command for running SQL from agents; a probe confirms the MCP endpoint is live and OAuth-gated with granular scopes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agents actually answer growth questions accurately via these paths, and governed semantic-layer metrics for canonical growth definitions are still beta.
